sentences.en: There will be an energy crisis in the near future.
sentences.zh: 不久的将来将会出现能源危机。

sentences.en: The newscaster puts too much emphasis on the food crisis.
sentences.zh: 播报员过分强调了粮食危机。

sentences.en: It was under these circumstances that the constitutional crisis began.
sentences.zh: 就是在这种情况下，宪法危机开始爆发。

senses.zh: 危机；决定性时刻；危险期 -
危机的；用于处理危机的
